description: Defines the ShareProductData class which models share product details including financial, accounting, and configuration data within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ShareProductData
classes.description: Immutable data class representing share product details, including financial, accounting, and configuration options, used across the Fineract platform.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Factory method to create a ShareProductData instance with core details and default null configurations.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template ShareProductData with specified options for currency, charges, and accounting mappings.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Creates a new ShareProductData instance with specified accounting mappings and related configurations.

methods.name: generic
methods.description: Creates a minimal ShareProductData with id, name, shortName, and totalShares.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal ShareProductData with id and name, used for lookup purposes.

methods.name: hasAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if the accounting rule indicates accounting is enabled.

methods.name: accountingRuleTypeId
methods.description: Returns the integer ID of the accounting rule type.
